test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caa6406b20b1421145231ef56f55eddcbf59ca3e2c0d70a6cb1b4be8f6dbdf27.png]
solution:
The pattern follows here is:

 
• **One dot, two dots, three dots moves one step in clockwise from figure to figure.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b92bb19be7e2cd38596aabfae49abb6c8d6d8e79669ed30f5ddfd60ac0d6af1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
